title: Stage skin (dsh.skin/1) — generic core, with optional levels and animated overlay
description: Declarative textbox/nameplate/font/text-effect/cursor/sfx override of the stage theme, optionally with levels 1..3 and an animated collage overlay (pieces anchored to runtime stage rects, stepped motion, cue timelines, glyph-set labels). No code, no CSS strings, no URLs. Installed as pack kind `skins`. Units: px at the 1600x900 reference stage.

layout.description: box = the theme text box; scrim = full-width bottom fade to the scene (dark paint.bg); card = a floating opaque card; slash = layered jagged black / white plates, tilted choice bars; bubble / panel / band = translucent plates (speech balloon with a tail / rimmed panel / wide band with a rule and corner flourishes) whose text keeps 4.5:1 over any scene.

frame.description: Ornament bands live in the border band only (outside the content rect).

page.description: The box frame on every new page, played from rest. bright is allowed, but a glow on every page turn reads as flicker.

tint.description: figure = the plate takes the speaker's image colour, lightness-adjusted to keep paint.fg readable.

enter.description: unfold = a new name's plate opens from a line through its middle (.1 s, the Vita original); the name shows at once. Still under reduced motion.

motion.description: The plate's entrance when the speaker changes (turns about its top).

font.description: Installed font ids (installed catalogue) or ids of the skin's own faces, every field optional. body is the stage role (text box; name, ui and titles fall back to it), film the cinematic subtitles (falls back to body, then the built-in subtitle stack). The user's per-machine override wins over ordinary skins; a director-applied performance skin's stage fonts win over it while active. Size, reduced motion and photosensitivity settings still apply.

sizeScale.description: multiplies the user's text size setting

narration.description: §18 N9: the ink of narration (a page with no speaker) in the box and the backlog, at least 7:1 on textbox.paint.bg.

wrap.description: phrase: the reading text breaks between phrases, not inside them - CJK runs keep whole up to punctuation or a space (word-break keep-all, strict kinsoku, the last lines evened out); a run wider than the line still breaks. From a 641px-wide screen; on phones the usual per-glyph breaking with kinsoku stays.

stepFps.description: How long each glyph pose holds, in whole 12/s steps: round(12 / stepFps).

flash.description: colour of a just-revealed glyph (transient; exempt from contrast)

emphasis.description: Entrance ink: none = body ink; ink = the flash; jitter = the flash plus a seeded per-glyph offset of jitter x 0.05em.

poses.description: The glyph's own entrance poses (step 0, 1, ...; then at rest), replacing the reveal's two.

layout.description: capsule / orb fold the quick buttons, film mode, effects and exit into the system menu opened from one top-right control.

place.description: Bar controls inside the text box; at 640px and below attach under the box as four 44px targets.

narrow.description: Where the placed row (place) stands at 640px and below: bottom (default, its own strip under the lines) or top (its own strip at the box's top edge, right-aligned under the box image's top band; the lines below it). edge: the row centred on the box's top edge (on the box image's top line), right-aligned; the lines keep only their own top room.

button.description: The icon row's controls drawn as one buttonArt body each (needs icons): the state image by the control's state - on while lit (auto / skip running, the menu open), disabled when it cannot act - the hover image over it under the pointer / keyboard focus, the action's icon in the glyph box.

sfx.description: The skin's sound palette: a cue it leaves out keeps the engine's sound (type / auto / skip have none). A page turn and a speaker change are never voiced (no page or name cue).

duck.description: How far (dB) a sounding voice or sound effect lowers each layer below it, each over the engine's amount.

figureSlots.description: Where the stage figures stand for a given number of figures on stage: key = count (1..6), value = that many strictly ascending centres as fractions of the stage width (0.1..0.9). Counts not listed use n + 1 equal gaps.

maxFigures.description: At most this many stage figures are drawn at once (a display limit: the stage state keeps every figure; the speaker and the most recent other speaker stay visible). Omitted = 3.

figures.description: How the original frames its figures: one zoom and head line for the whole cast (relative heights stay the shared ruler's). Omitted = the shared stage framing.

scale.description: A multiplier on the shared stage scale (above 1 frames closer, cropping lower).

top.description: Where the tallest figure's head top stands (with ruler: a figure of the ruler's height), as a share of the stage height from the top.

ruler.description: A fixed camera (cm): the cast is sized on this height instead of the scene's tallest figure, so a very tall or very short figure never moves or shrinks the others; and the size is the drawn count's (maxFigures), never shrunk by figures present off screen. Omitted = the scene's tallest figure and the whole present cast.

spread.description: The share of the shared ruler's (log) height gap between a figure and the ruler that shows, for figures of a metre and taller (the original draws its cast's heights closer together); smaller bodies keep their real centimetres. Omitted = 1.

mode.description: none = the stage draws no figures (presentation only: the cast and its state go on; a bust portrait still shows the speaker). Omitted = stage.

dimListeners.description: false = figures who are not speaking keep full light (the stage dims them by default).

hud.description: The top bar of stage entries (背景, BGM, 声音, 手机, 弹幕, 电影模式, ✕): auto = hidden while reading, revealed by a mouse near the top, focus or the open menu (default); always = always shown. The player's CONFIG 顶栏按钮 overrides it.

plate.description: An opaque ground behind the top bar's chips (place, BGM, 声音, the top-right buttons) so their labels read over a bright scene; fg is their ink on it (contrast >= 4.5:1).

timer.description: While the stage shows a timer: hide puts away drawn art.buttons (the timer can stand where the menu gear was, in dialogue and debate alike; Esc still opens the menu). A mode's own hud.hide adds to it while the mode is on.

art.description: Bundle images drawn as the textbox and as on-stage quick buttons, placed in px of a design screen `screen` px tall and `screenWidth` px wide (the game area: the largest rect of that aspect inside the stage; without screenWidth, the stage height narrowed so the box fits). On phones (640px and less) the box fits the width (9-sliced to its lines) and the buttons take a touch size.

images.description: The box per speaker side; plain = narration or a speaker not drawn on stage.

narration.description: The box image for narration pages, else plain.

body.description: The box rect inside the image: x, y, width, height (image px).

bottom.description: The image's bottom margin on the screen (px).

text.description: Text column left, right and the vertical centre of the text block (image px).

cue.description: Page cue centre x, resting bottom y and height (image px), or inline (follows the page's last glyph); omitted = no page cue.

rise.description: How far the page cue bobs up (px).

pitch.description: Line pitch of the box text (px).

align.description: top: text[2] is the top of the first line, not the centre of the block. middle (§18 N9): phones too centre the page's lines in the box (wide stages centre by default).

lamp.description: An image shown on the box image (x, y = its top-left, image px) while auto-advance runs: the original's AUTO lamp, not a button.

motion.description: blink: shown for the first 51.6% of each period (stepped visibility); spin: one counter-clockwise turn per period, eased in and out (eased rotation).

swap.description: The lamp stands in for the page cue while auto runs.

frames.description: The lamp played as a sheet (#/$defs/frames) while it shows: its motion, so neither motion nor period with it.

span.description: stage: the box image stretched across the whole stage width (a bottom-stretch scrim); the text column stays the design one.

next.description: The page cue drawn from this image (its natural size, centred on cue) instead of the cursor canvas; {image, frames} plays it as a sheet (#/$defs/frames: one cell is the cue, the frames its motion - no rise, dip or blink).

bob.description: dip: the cue dips `rise` px and returns (.917 s) instead of rising; blink: it blinks at 2 Hz in place.

tint.description: The box images' trim (each mask's alpha: rim, glow, printed tab) takes the speaker's own colour with its luminance kept; without one the images show as drawn.

by.description: The colour's source: the speaking figure's own colour.

masks.description: Per box image, a mask of the same size whose alpha is the share recoloured.

cue.description: The page cue's colours follow the speaker's too (their luminance kept).

menu.description: The stage menu's accent follows the speaker's colour too (its luminance kept, darkened where needed to stay readable on the panel); narration keeps the skin's own.

scale.description: The box images (and the next cue image) drawn at this many px per image px (and a cast box, art.cast); body, text and cue stay design px.

fit.description: The share of the stage width the box image may take (default .96); 1 for a box image as wide as the original's HUD row.

height.description: fit lines: the box's height follows the page's line count, between min and max lines. The body is drawn for `lines` lines; each line more or fewer moves its top edge by one line pitch (the box image 9-sliced by slice, the name, controls and portrait riding the top edge), eased over ms (default 220; none under CONFIG 减少动态). Pages hold up to max lines. Not with tint or span.

stroke.description: An outline around the box text (the Vita's white text edged in dark): colour and width (px).

halo.description: The box text's soft halo (the original's text underlay): offset, blur, colour and opacity.

controls.description: The quick menu row on the box image (wide stages): right edge x, top y, each control size px square, gap apart.

w.description: Each control's width (a label tag); default size (square).

rows.description: §18 N9: the controls in a grid of that many rows from y down, columns from x leftward (wide stages).

slice.description: Phones: the slice (#/$defs/slice, image px) kept when the box image is 9-sliced to the lines at the reading size; default everything outside the text block.

readout.description: A live local clock printed on the box image: label then HH:MM:SS (updated every second), right-aligned at x (align start: from x), centred on y (image px), font px in ink. narrow = its place on phones (640px and less) in CSS px from the box (the drawn card): x in from its right edge (align end) or left edge (start; default the readout align), y from its top edge down to the line middle. Without narrow a phone keeps the design place, its top at least half a line under the box top edge and its end one em in from the right edge.

nameplate.description: The layout's name plate placed on the box image (image px): top-left x, y, height h, least width w, the name size font, its glyph outline stroke (nameplate.paint.border) and a drawn speaker's emblem disc [centre x, centre y, diameter].

image.description: The plate drawn from this image at its natural size (the layout's own plate steps aside).

text.description: The name's inset from the plate image's left (px).

weight.description: The name's weight on an image plate.

printed.description: The box images carry the plate (the original's printed tab): the layout draws the name only, centred on the plate height h at y; w = the printed tab's room for the name (a longer name is set smaller to fit, and on phones the name keeps the image's scale, never past the tab's height). Not with image or nameplate.tint.

sides.description: Per speaker side (data-speaker-side), the name's x on the box image; a box without a side (the plain image) keeps x.

scale.description: The plate image (and a cast plate) drawn at this many px per image px (text stays design px).

fill.description: The name's ink in two bands [upper half, lower half], split at the glyphs' middle, under its outline (stroke, nameplate.paint.border).

shadow.description: The outline's drop shadow offset [dx, dy] (px), in the outline colour: with fill the outline copy's, otherwise the outlined name's.

spacing.description: The name's own letter spacing (em); unset, the name keeps the skin's text spacing.

center.description: With an image plate: the name is centred on this x (px from the plate's left) instead of starting `text` px in.

band.description: A strip under the name that follows its width (the PSP's dark band, its dotted rule and its two teeth): the image drawn h px tall at its own aspect, from x (px past the plate's left, where it is cut) to the name's right edge plus tail (its right edge anchored there), at y (design px). A printed pattern keeps its geometry at any name width.

tint.description: The band painted in the speaker's colour through the image's alpha (as drawn without one).

sweep.description: ms the band takes to draw itself left to right when the speaker changes.

lift.description: The name this many px above the plate's middle (its line box is centred there; negative = lower).

initials.description: The name set by part (the original's author label): the family name's first glyph `lead` px in the speaker colour, the rest of it `rest` px, the given name's first glyph given[0] px and its rest given[1] px, `gap` px between the parts, the small glyphs `drop` px low. The given name is the longest of the figure's other names that ends the name; without one the whole name is the family part.

slice.description: The image plate 9-sliced (#/$defs/slice) grows along the name - down for a vertical plate, right for a level one. Needs image.

grow.description: With slice: how far (design px) the plate grows past its drawn size along the name before the name shrinks.

pad.description: With slice: the name's clearance [start, end] (design px along the name) from the plate's two ends; default the slice edges there.

vertical.description: Upright top-to-bottom name. text and center measure height; long names shrink to 0.6, never ellipsise.

rotate.description: The printed name turned this many degrees (a tilted drawn plate).

narrow.description: pill: on phones the name leaves the plate drawn in the box image for a pill in the speaker's colour on the box's top edge, the box showing its narration image. level: on phones the drawn plate (hanging or level) is set as a level tag - the name in one line on a tag in nameplate.paint over the box's top edge at its left, the lines below it. under: on phones the same level tag inside the box, just under the art.portrait.narrow side and centred on its axis (with a face; the side's top without one), kept to the side's column (a long name is set smaller to fit); the box's top edge keeps no room for it. Needs art.portrait.narrow.

wide.description: under (§18 N16): on wide stages (over 640px), while a face shows, the plate stands just under the art.portrait window (6 design px below it), centred on its axis, and the lines keep the box's own top (no room above them for the name); a page without a face keeps x / y (and lead). The skin leaves the room under the window. Needs axis portrait.

lead.description: §18 N9: the plate leads the lines - on a page without a face (art bare) it moves with them to the face's place (a hanging plate and a level one alike).

tint.description: The name's glyphs take the speaker's colour at the luminance of nameplate.paint.fg (the luminosity blend art.textbox.tint uses), so they read as the plain ink does; narration and a speaker without a colour keep nameplate.paint.fg.

axis.description: §18 N14: a level plate's name centred on the shown face's vertical axis (art.portrait: its frame window, else its square; on a phone the narrow side), whatever its length - a long name grows the plate both ways (grow), then shrinks; the plate never passes the box's left edge. A page without a face keeps x (or lead). Needs art.portrait; not with vertical, sides or printed.

cast.description: Per-figure art keyed by the figure id in the skin's own pack: box = the textbox image for every line of that speaker (any side), plate = the name plate image (nameplate.image's size), name = the name's two-band ink and outline colour.

band.description: This speaker's nameplate.band (its own image and tail); false = no band.

decor.description: Still HUD prints of the original that have no action here (e.g. a HELP label), placed like buttons; never focusable.

narration.description: Narration without a box; optional image-preserving band and visual-line entrance.

y.description: The block's vertical centre on the design screen (px from its top; default its middle).

band.description: Image-preserving subtitle band. Design pixels; omitted values use engine defaults (font 30, pitch 43, bottom 0, veil 80/255).

lines.description: Visual-line entrance: fade and stagger in seconds, optional rise in design pixels. Skip and reduced motion reveal immediately.

choices.description: The end-of-round menu as image bars (every row: the choices, 生成选项, 自由输入, 重新生成): a stack centred on `center`, `gap` px between bars; the text in textbox.paint.fg. A bar grows past its image height through the 9-slice `slice` (wide and narrow stages).

images.description: plain = a bar; off = a bar that cannot act (busy or disabled).

alt.description: The even rows' own bar (alternating colours).

text.description: Text column left, right and the vertical centre of the text block (image px).

band.description: Optional [top, bottom] image rows where every bar image keeps its fill under the text column's glyphs, around the text centre; its edges lie in the end slices, so a taller row keeps it. Default: line boxes 12 px inside the image.

gap.description: Space between two bars (px); negative overlaps them (the original's layout spacing).

center.description: The stack's vertical centre on the design screen (px from its top).

tint.description: A mask the size of the plain bar, sliced as the bar, whose alpha takes the colour of the box trim - the last speaker's before the menu (needs textbox.tint); the off bar stays as drawn.

tool.description: 重新生成 drawn as this image (the label kept for assistive tech), `h` px high, centred at `x` px on the 自由输入 bar, which then takes the whole row; without it the two share the row as half bars.

x.description: Centre on the bar (bar image px from its left).

tint.description: A mask the size of the tool image whose alpha takes the colour of the box trim (needs textbox.tint).

send.description: The 自由输入 row has one control on every skin: while its draft is empty it is 重新生成, drawn as image; with text it is 发送, drawn as this image (the tool image's size; tint applies), and sends it. The swap turns the badge over in .22 s (instant under 减少动态); Enter still sends. Required with tool; a skin without tool art gets the shared replay / send glyphs in its own ink.

button.description: Instead of image / send / tint: the control drawn as one buttonArt body (normal, hover, disabled) with the action's own icon (重新生成 / 发送) in its glyph box, in ink.

ink.description: With button: the icon's colour, or [at rest, under the pointer / keyboard focus] for a body that lights up.
The words' colour on the plain bar (default textbox.paint.fg).

focus.description: The bar under the pointer or keyboard focus: its image (same size and slices as plain) and its words' colour, instead of the accent words.

dx.description: The focused bar steps this many design px sideways.

alt.description: The even rows' own focus bar.

ray.description: Wide stages: a laser line from the focused bar's middle on to the stage's edges (alt = the even rows' colour; width in bar px).

number.description: The suggestion rows numbered 01, 02, ... centred at x (bar px), font px, ink / focusInk, dy off the bar's middle.

free.description: The free-input row's cell mark (instead of a number).

numerals.description: Seal numerals 一 二 三 in the name face instead of 01 02 03.

anchor.description: Instead of center: where the stack stands on wide stages - stage = centred on the game area's height, the box stepping aside while it shows (as with center); above-box = centred in the room above the box image's top, the box staying in view.

buttons.description: Existing quick actions drawn on the stage: backlog (LOG), auto and skip (to the round's end), and menu - the stage menu (Esc), the one entry to everything the original lacks (replaces the quickMenu fold control). On phones (640px and less) they hang from the top edge at a touch size (the smallest 36px): a top button keeps its top, those placed from the bottom keep their arrangement under that side's top buttons.

backlog.description: The backlog (履历) drawn as the original's log screen on wide stages (needs screenWidth). sheet = an image over the game area; dim = the stage's dim behind it (black at this opacity); title / close = placed images (the words stay the accessible names); list = the scroll viewport [x, y, w, h]; every entry's text at font px on pitch px lines in the column text [left, right] (px from the list's left), top px under its head, entries gap px apart; voice = where the row's voice control stands (drawn by art.voice; omitted = right after the name, centred on it); name = a spoken line's name (left x, top y, height h, font px, head = the height its head takes before the text) over a frame and above a rule image placed in the entry; scrollbar = a drawn position indicator. Design pixels. hover = the one highlight: behind the entry under the pointer / keyboard focus and the current entry (the hover wins: the current entry's steps aside while another row is hovered). The sheet is stretched over the whole panel at any window shape; the placed parts stay on the game area.

title.description: A placed image: its top-left at x, y on the design screen at scale design px per image px; focus = the image under the pointer and keyboard focus.

close.description: A placed image: its top-left at x, y on the design screen at scale design px per image px; focus = the image under the pointer and keyboard focus.

voice.description: The row's voice replay control place, the skin's own (omitted = right after the speaker's name, centred on it). A box [x, y, w, h] from the entry's top-left (= anchor row), or anchor + at [dx, dy] + size [w, h]: row = its top-left at the entry's top-left + at; name = its left edge at the name's end + dx, centred on the name + dy; text = its left edge at the text column's right end + dx, centred on the first line + dy. size omitted = a square growing with the lines. Wide stages only; a phone keeps it after the name.

frame.description: A placed image: its top-left at x, y on the design screen at scale design px per image px; focus = the image under the pointer and keyboard focus.

rule.description: A placed image: its top-left at x, y on the design screen at scale design px per image px; focus = the image under the pointer and keyboard focus.

hover.description: A highlight behind an element (the current one, or the one under the pointer and keyboard focus): its image stretched over the element (irregular edges: the image's own; never a flat fill), out = its overhang [top, right, bottom, left] in design px (negative = inset).

config.description: CONFIG drawn as the original's options screen on wide stages (needs screenWidth); its pages stay the stage's own. sheet (stretched over the whole panel) / dim / title / close as art.backlog; tabs = the tab images (plain, on = the open tab) stacked from x, y every pitch px, the label in the column text [left, right, middle] at font px; page = the rows' rect [x, y, w, h], each row `row` px high with its control column `control` px wide; focus = the row's hover image; slider = track, fill, frame, thumb and focus (thumb under the pointer) images, h = the track's height, thumbSize = the thumb's; toggle = the cell of the segmented choices, switches and pickers (plain, on = chosen, focus = hover, frame = its outline; h = its height). Design pixels.

title.description: A placed image: its top-left at x, y on the design screen at scale design px per image px; focus = the image under the pointer and keyboard focus.

close.description: A placed image: its top-left at x, y on the design screen at scale design px per image px; focus = the image under the pointer and keyboard focus.

select.description: The pickers (font, skin) as the original's drop-down bar: plain, focus (open / under the pointer), its height h and its words' ink.

voice.description: Every voice replay control (the backlog rows' and the box's replay) drawn from these images in its box: idle, focus (hover / keyboard) and active (playing). box false = the textbox shows no replay control (the original's box has none): replay stays on its key (R) and in the backlog. backlog false = the backlog's rows show no replay control (an original whose log has none): replay stays on its key (R) and in the box. Needs image unless box or backlog is false.

scale.description: The images drawn at this many design px per image px (e.g. a raster made for a 3840-wide design screen in a 2000-wide skin: 0.52).

confirm.description: The stage's confirm dialogs (重新生成 ...) drawn as the original's dialog band on wide stages (needs screenWidth): band = the body image stretched over the band, top / bottom = the torn edges at its top and bottom (natural size, full width), h = the band's least height, pad [top, bottom], gap between its rows, width = the content column, dim = the stage's dim behind it; the words at font px in ink. button = the choices and actions as the original's buttons: plain and focus images at their natural size, the label at font px (ink / focusInk), lead = the first glyph's colour under focus, gap px apart. Design pixels.

menu.description: The stage menu drawn as the original's own menu screen on wide stages (needs screenWidth; narrow stages keep the shared panel in the skin's palette). sheet = an image stretched over the whole panel behind it (edge to edge at any window shape; rows and strips stay on the game area); rows = every item as a 9-sliced bar image; title / info / keys = strips carrying the menu title, the focused item's description and the key guide. Design pixels. Either rows (bars) or tiles (a grid of drawn tiles keyed by action id). frame = an image the menu stands on (a device: the original's phone) at its top-left x, y on the design screen, turned rotate degrees (clockwise) about its centre; with a frame, tiles and strips are in frame px and turn with it. dim = the menu's veil replaced by the stage dimmed to black at this opacity (0 = the menu over the live scene).

tiles.description: The menu as a grid of drawn tiles instead of bars. art = per action id (the menu's own ids) its tile image (focus = under the pointer and keyboard focus); at = an always-present action (resume, backlog, gallery, config, keys, leave) out of the grid at its own top-left, its image at its natural size (the original's close mark); bare = no visible label there (needs at). The grid: the first cell's top-left x, y, cells w x h every pitch [x, y] px, cols per row in the menu's order, each tile image centred on its cell + offset; fit = the grid's most height (more rows scale the grid down to it). label = the words centred in the cell at y at font px (ink / focusInk; the first glyph lead times larger, in focusInk under focus; halo; stroke = a hard outline under the ink). hover = a highlight behind the focused tile; plain = the tile of an action without its own image.

hover.description: A highlight behind an element (the current one, or the one under the pointer and keyboard focus): its image stretched over the element (irregular edges: the image's own; never a flat fill), out = its overhang [top, right, bottom, left] in design px (negative = inset).

stroke.description: A hard outline round the label glyphs, under the ink (the original's light rim): colour and width (px).

align.description: start: the words from label.x in the cell (a list row).

number.description: The tiles numbered 01, 02, ... in the menu's order at x, y (cell px), font px, ink / focusInk, an outline stroke (not with hover).

tilt.description: Each tile's own angle (degrees), cycled by its place in the menu.

lift.description: The focused tile's scale and rise (design px).

rows.description: Bars: plain, focus (the focused item) and off (cannot act) images, slice [top, right, bottom, left], label column [l, r] centred on y at font px, the first bar's top-left x, y and the gap between bars; cursor = an image beside the focused bar, top-left from the bar's.

align.description: The label's place in its text column.

motion.description: The drawn menu's items staged in (enter) and out (leave), in design px.

blur.description: The stage behind the menu blurred (design px).

grey.description: The stage behind the menu greyed (0..1).

decor.description: hide: art.decor put away while the menu is open.

signal.description: A lamp image at x, y (frame px with a frame) showing its alert image while one of the on actions has the focus.

portrait.description: The speaker's portrait for an ADV layout: a square `size` px wide, its left edge at `left`, its bottom `bottom` px above the screen's bottom edge, showing the mood avatar (source avatar, the default). source bust = the speaker's upper body cut from their stage figure, framed by `bust`; the square stays for a speaker without a figure on stage.

when.description: always (the default): every speaker with an avatar shows it. off-stage: on wide stages (over 640px) a speaker drawn on stage shows no face (the figure is the speaker; the page is faceless, as narration); a speaker who is not on stage shows it. Phones show every face.

placeholder.description: §18 N16: a speaker the avatar resolver gives no face shows a stand-in instead of a faceless page - initial = the engine's neutral disc (the displayed name's first glyph in nameplate.paint), {image} = the skin's own art. Narration shows none. Undeclared: such a page stays faceless (as before).

feather.description: [top, right, bottom, left]: the face picture fades to transparent over that share of the face square from each edge (0 = a hard edge), so a cut-out or an opaque avatar melts into what is behind it instead of ending on a straight cut. Phones too.

frame.description: The portrait frame: image (natural size) with its left edge at left and its bottom bottom px above the screen's bottom edge, drawn behind the face and only while a face shows (narration and a speaker without an avatar show no frame). window = [left, bottom, width, height] in design px, the rect the face is clipped to (the picture under the face square shows down to its bottom); default the square. Not with source bust.

mood.description: A caption in the frame bound to the shown face's 差分 (emotion) label: rect = [left, bottom, width, height] in design px (width / height > 0), the label centred in it at font px in ink, weight and letter spacing (em) optional. The label is the figure's own readable emotion name through the shared resolver, never an id; a state without a label leaves it empty.

round.description: The face is clipped to the ellipse inside window (a round frame) instead of the rect.

front.description: The frame and the face stand over the box image, the frame image in front of the face (an open frame the face shows through); default the frame behind the face, both under the box image.

glass.description: An image laid over the face across window (stretched to it, clipped as the face): a sheen, a ripple, glass. Under a front frame.

speaking.description: The frame image while the speaker's line is still being delivered - its words typing or its voice playing (same size as image); else image.

motion.description: The frame and its face entering together when a new speaker's face comes in (not a mood change): the pose keys of nameplate.motion with dx / dy in % of the frame (-200..200; dy 100 = one frame height down, e.g. risen from under the box image drawn over it). layer face: the face alone moves (% of the face square) and the frame stays still; leave: the outgoing face's own poses (<= 400 ms). A click that finishes the page, skip, history and 减少动态 show the rest pose at once.

tint.description: A mask the size of image whose alpha takes the speaker's colour (the box's speaker colour, as textbox.tint), the frame's luminance kept; it scales with the frame (phones too). Narration and a speaker without a colour keep the frame as drawn. Not applied to speaking.

back.description: An image under the face across window (stretched to it, shaped by its own alpha - cut it to the window's ellipse for a round frame): what the window shows around a cut-out avatar. Only while a face shows.

fill.description: The window's own opaque face under the back and the face: one colour, or [centre, edge] (a radial gradient). What shows through a cut-out avatar's transparent parts instead of the stage behind; shaped as the face (the window's ellipse when round). Only while a face shows.

name.description: The speaker's name set on the frame along a circle: arc = [x, bottom, r], the circle's centre on the design screen and its radius (design px, r > 0; the glyphs' middles on it), the words centred on its lowest point (side bottom, default) or highest (top) within span degrees (default 90); font px, ink (one colour, or [top, bottom] down the glyphs), weight, spacing (em), engrave {light, dark} = the cut's edges. Any name (live text) stays inside the span's arc, never over the frame's ornaments past it: set smaller (down to .72), then its tracking closed (to -.04em), then smaller again. While it shows, the box's name plate steps aside (its words kept for screen readers; its voice control centred at voice [x, bottom], default 12° past the arc's right end); narration and a speaker without a face keep the plate. Legibility: stroke {color, width} outlines the glyphs, shadow {color, dx, dy} sets one hard offset copy behind, bed {color, alpha, width} darkens the channel behind the run, min floors the size (past it the run is pressed narrower).

stroke.description: Outline round the glyphs: width design px outside their edge, on the ink itself (paint-order stroke, then fill).

shadow.description: One hard copy of the outlined glyphs behind them, offset dx / dy design px (vector, no blur).

bed.description: The channel darkened behind the run: a soft band of color at alpha, width design px across (default the font size).

min.description: Smallest size the name is set at (design px, not above font); past it the run is pressed narrower at the same height.

swap.description: §18 N14: a new face crossfades in the still window (the face it replaces fading out under it) instead of the cut; not with motion (that owns the entrance).

bust.description: Required with source bust (and only then).

head.description: Where the figure's head box (crown to chin) lands on the design screen: its centre x, its top y, its height (px, at least 16).

crop.description: What of the figure shows, in head heights: above the crown, to each side of the head centre, below the chin (the design screen clips too).

enter.description: A new subject's first pose (dx px, opacity) and how it reaches rest over ms: hold = a cut after ms (default), out = an ease. Still under reduced motion.

narrow.description: Stages of 640px and less (§13): the face side (the frame, or the square without one) width CSS px wide, its height by the frame's aspect, x px from the box's left edge and y px from its top edge (negative: above it); the lines start clear of it whether a face shows or not. name = how a frame name reads there: below (one straight line centred under the side, default) or arc (needs frame.name) (with nameMin, its floor in CSS px); flow / left = how the lines clear the side.

nameMin.description: The arc name's smallest glyph size on a phone (CSS px): a name that would set smaller keeps that height and is condensed to its arc (vector glyphs).

flow.description: How the lines clear the side: beside (a column right of it, default), wrap (beside it down to its bottom, then the full width), below (all under it, full width).

left.description: The lines' left inset from the box's left edge when they are not beside the side (CSS px, default 12).

item.description: The items mod's card drawn in a skin-provided frame. frame = the frame image, drawn as box [centre x, centre y, width, height] on the design screen (needs screenWidth); media = the item picture's [width, height], centred on the frame and drawn over it (contained). The card keeps the items mod's own lifetime and shows no 获得 / 失去 caption, name, spotlight or zoom; only the newest card shows. enter = it rises from `rise` px below while fading in over ms, mirrored as it leaves. narrow = on stages of 640px and less the frame centred, `width` of the stage wide, its centre `y` of the stage height down (default: the design placement scaled). gain = for an item gained: hideText hides the text box's words, name and page cue while the card shows (the box art stays); toast = the original's notice, its image as box [x, y, width, height] on the design screen with text centred in it at font px (ink; default the stage HUD ink), fading in and out over fadeMs.

spinner.description: A skin-owned loading mark. A static SVG/PNG/WebP may spin, sway or pulse, or a sheet plays equal-sized cells in row-major order. No executable SVG or arbitrary CSS. Or parts: 2-4 marks drawn as one unit (each its own image and motion, placed by box in one shared design frame); the unit is 1.4em x scale high.

motion.description: Default spin; sheet implies frames. Reduced motion freezes the mark.

period.description: Seconds per turn (spin) or per swing (sway).

loop.description: Default true; false holds the last frame.

sheet.description: Equal cells, left to right then top to bottom; frames cannot exceed columns * rows.

box.description: [x, y, w, h] of this part in the unit's shared design frame (the original's own layout).

motion.description: Default spin; sheet implies frames. Reduced motion freezes the mark.

period.description: Seconds per turn (spin) or per swing (sway).

at.description: [x, y, size]: the spinner stands at this centre on the design screen, its longer side size px (the original's own loading mark), instead of beside the load line; wide art stages only.

place.description: Where the loader stands: center (default, the centred group) or bottom-right (the stage's bottom-right corner on no plate, as an original loading mark; the slow-load line rides above it). Not with at.

words.description: The loader art carries its own loading words (e.g. 数据加载中…): the veil and the slow notice draw no engine caption, step line or progress bar beside it (screen readers still hear the step).

loop.description: Default true; false holds the last frame.

sheet.description: Equal cells, left to right then top to bottom; frames cannot exceed columns * rows.

backlog.description: The 履历 (backlog) drawn by entry role: every entry has one role - speech (a character's line), player (the player's input), narration, notice (a performance's row: a check, an item, a title card or a mod's, by its registered backlog.role), divider (the round line). layout list = the reading sheet (with art.backlog its art); overlay = the entries straight over the dimmed stage, closed from a corner button. A role left out takes the layout's default look (list: row / rule; overlay: speech and player bubble, narration and notice band, divider none). No backlog = today's list.

anchor.description: §18 N9: the list only as tall as its rows, standing at the panel's bottom (by the box).

dim.description: overlay: black at this opacity over the stage (default the panel veil).

look.description: row = the list's own row; bubble = a speech balloon with a tail toward the speaker's stage side (the player right), the name inside at the tail's end; band = a plate across the column, words centred; plaque = a small centred plate; rule = the round divider line; none = no entry.

paint.description: The plate's paint: bg at the look's opacity, fg the words, border its rim, line a thin outer line round the rim. Default the textbox paint (a band unpainted: its negative). The words keep 4.5:1 over a black or white scene through the plate.

opacity.description: The plate fill's opacity (default bubble / plaque .9, band .8).

name.description: bubble only: the name's ink (default the speaker's image colour).

tint.description: bubble only: the outer line and the name in the speaker's image colour (the character colour, the one authority); fallback for a speaker without one (the player).

wrap.description: band / plaque only: the open and close marks round the words, e.g. ["<", ">"].

metrics.description: The plates measured on the original, in design px of art.screen (needs art.screenWidth). Phones scale them by the words' size (the body at the reading size).

h.description: The least height; more lines grow it.

inset.description: The outer edge's distance from its side of the game area.

rim.description: The rim's width inside the line.

tail.description: [base top, base bottom, tip out past the side, tip y], from the bubble's top.

name.description: [x from the tail side's outer edge, top, font].

text.description: [left padding, right padding, the words' vertical centre from the top, font, line pitch].

close.description: The corner close's top-left on the game area and its size.
The one visible close: head = the title row's right end; corner = the overlay's bottom-left button, a framed × (paint: fg the ×, bg its face, border the frame, 3:1 against black).

paint.description: The plate's paint: bg at the look's opacity, fg the words, border its rim, line a thin outer line round the rim. Default the textbox paint (a band unpainted: its negative). The words keep 4.5:1 over a black or white scene through the plate.

badge.description: How a mod-declared line kind's badge (its {line:{label}}, e.g. 手机) is drawn on its 履历 line - every line kind alike, never one mod. show false hides the mark only, keeping the line's text and behaviour; omitted keeps it. look pill = an outline capsule (the default), solid = a filled chip (needs paint.bg), bracket = the word in 【】 (no bg or border); icon line = the kind's icon as declared (the default), bold = its lines thickened (a skin whose own glyphs are chunky); place name = after the speaker's name (the default), text = ahead of the words; paint fg the word, bg the chip (fg keeps 4.5:1 on it), border its outline. Omitted = a pill after the name in the panel's muted ink.

effects.description: How the core stage effects look in this skin: one entry per core effect id, every field optional and merged over the engine default (card-local > skin > engine). The director only names the id; nothing here reaches the prompt.

params.description: Look params (numbers, #rrggbb colours, short number arrays, small objects of them); no images.
Look params (numbers, #rrggbb colours, short number arrays, small objects of them); no images.

transition.description: The scene change the director leaves unspecified (default; blink = two eyelids close over the stage and open on the new scene; slash = four slanted bars sweep across) and the black / white / blink cover's linear close, hold and open (s).

thinking.description: The inner-monologue backdrop: an image from the bundle stretched to over x the stage (else the engine's dim), its dim and vignette when drawn by the engine, fade [in, out] s.

levels.description: Optional levels 1..3. Plain skins omit this (single look).

overlay.description: Optional animated collage frame around the runtime stage rects (doc §16). Ordinary skins omit it.

glyphs.description: dsh.glyphs/1 glyph-set id used by labels/decals/cover runes/nameTag; resolved in this bundle (glyphs/<id>.json), then the pack

clock.description: Defaults for every piece's own stepped clock.

shadow.description: Collage drop shadow (the piece silhouette in near-black). lead = the shadow takes its idle pose this many steps ahead of the body.

labels.description: Rune paper strips typeset at load time (never baked into atlases). Referenced as frame label:<id>.

decals.description: Runtime compositing onto an atlas frame (rune text, TV noise, colour bars). Referenced as frame decal:<id>.

nameTag.description: Rune sticker stuck on top of the name plate (over layer, decorative, aria-hidden): the speaker's romanised name.

events.description: Idle 'small events' (every n..m ms during idle).

intrusion.description: The one signature intrusion (front layer) this barrier may perform.

sfx.description: Cue id -> short audio file in the bundle. Missing ids are silent.

modes.description: The skin's other text presentations, keyed by the mode a performance declares (dsh.performance/1 skinMode): while the stage's current performance declares skinMode <id>, modes.<id> is on - the statement: no box, name or cue; the page's words large over the scene, centred on the place for the speaker's side. Presentation only (pages and history unchanged). Needs art.

buttons.description: Quick actions the original draws only in this mode (such as fast-forward next to the timer), as art.buttons and placed the same way; shown while the mode is on and no title phase holds the dialogue.

hud.description: The HUD while the mode is on: hide puts away drawn art.buttons (the debate has no menu gear; Esc still opens the menu); beside: "timer" stands the mode's buttons in one row just left of the stage timer, centred on it, while one shows (their own places otherwise), gap design px apart (negative: transparent margins overlap).

stroke.description: The glyph outline (design px) in textbox.paint.bg.

places.description: Per speaker side, the block's centre x, y (design px) and its roll (degrees, counter-clockwise); plain = narration and an undrawn speaker.

transitions.description: How the stage surfaces come and go, at every width. Data only: wipes through closed shapes, poses, fades and flat sweeping shapes; the engine plays them with transforms, opacity and clip paths.

loading.description: The loading veil: enter = it covers the stage, leave = it uncovers the revealed stage.

stage.description: enter = the text box as the stage is revealed; leave = the whole stage before it closes (返回主页面, ✕, F12).

menu.description: The Esc system menu (any width; art.menu.motion still stages a drawn menu's items).

choices.description: The turn-end choices: enter = each row (stagger ms apart), leave = after a pick (the others first, the picked row last); the pick is sent when it ends.

page.description: A page turn: enter only, shapes only (the box's own page motion is textbox.motion.page).

speaker.description: A speaker change (to someone, from narration or another speaker): enter only, shapes only, played instead of nothing; a page of the same speaker plays page.

config.description: The stage CONFIG screen's own look at every width. The engine keeps what the screen holds, its keys, focus order and the settings; the skin picks the frame, tab list, section heads, rows and one look per control type. Omitted = the engine look of today.

frame.description: sheet = the centred sheet, drawer = a full-height panel from one side with the stage beside it, full = the whole stage. side = the drawer side; width = share of the stage width (sheet, drawer).

look.description: Closed look; the first word is the engine look of today (the default).

paint.description: The CONFIG panel's own seed colours (opaque); checked like ui: fg / bg and accent / bg >= 4.5, fgMuted / bg >= 3, onAccent / accent >= 4.5. Hover, selected and disabled shades are derived by the engine.

plate.description: One image stretched over the part by its nine-slice (image px); scale = CSS px per image px at the sliced edges (default 1).

texture.description: A quiet pattern in the panel ink over the frame: halftone dots, hatch (diagonal), ruled (writing-paper lines).

backdrop.description: What is drawn behind the frame: an image covering the stage and / or a veil.

title.description: The CONFIG title is 设置. word = one replacement word in its place (1-24 characters; no Latin letters, spaces or separators, never paired with 设置 - no second label; the accessible name stays 设置); vertical = set top to bottom beside the tab list; hidden = no visible title.

look.description: Closed look; the first word is the engine look of today (the default).

plate.description: One image stretched over the part by its nine-slice (image px); scale = CSS px per image px at the sliced edges (default 1).

nav.description: The tab list: tabs = the stacked list, index = large numerals over the names, pills = rounded chips. place start / end / top (top wraps onto more lines, never a sideways scroller); numerals = the number before each tab.

look.description: Closed look; the first word is the engine look of today (the default).

paint.description: The tab list's own opaque ground and inks (e.g. a gold leaf beside a dark page), checked like frame.paint: fg / bg and accent / bg >= 4.5, fgMuted / bg >= 3; onBg = the open tab's ink on the panel's bg (its plate, nav.plate.on, drawn in the page's colours) >= 4.5.

plate.description: The part drawn by state images: plain at rest, on = chosen / open, focus = under the pointer or keyboard focus; sliced and scaled like a plate.

section.description: The section heads: caption = a small spaced word over a rule, rule = the word between two rules, band = the word on a full-width band, numbered = a large ordinal beside it; sticky = the head stays at the top while its rows scroll.

look.description: Closed look; the first word is the engine look of today (the default).

plate.description: One image stretched over the part by its nine-slice (image px); scale = CSS px per image px at the sliced edges (default 1).

row.description: The setting rows: plain = no dividers (today), line = rows split by one divider, card = each row on its own plate. label start (beside the control) or above; density compact / regular / airy; columns 2 = two rows side by side on wide frames (one column below 960 CSS px).

plate.description: The part drawn by state images: plain at rest, on = chosen / open, focus = under the pointer or keyboard focus; sliced and scaled like a plate.

controls.description: One look per control type (data-fk-control on each row). other = every type the skin does not list and every type the engine or a mod adds later (the fallback), and the engine's composite rows.

thumb.description: The thumb image at its natural size times scale; focus = under the pointer / keyboard focus.

scroll.description: fade edge = the page fades out on the side that has more rows to scroll to.

motion.description: rows = how rows enter when a tab opens (none with reduced motion); stagger = ms between rows (the first six rows of each section).

shape.description: The text box drawn as vector shapes in design px (geometry is skin data). view = the drawn rect [x, y, w, h]; boxes = one per text row count (the last for more rows); narration = the box of a narration page (default: the boxes).

stretch.description: Per axis: max(min, base + width x the text width + line x (rows - 1)) in design px; y as x when omitted. Omitted: 0.

turn.description: Each page turns parts by one of deg (picked from the page text) about pivot.

origin.description: Where the page's entrance (the layout's motion) grows from.

parts.description: Drawn in order; remount each page.

still.description: Drawn after parts; never turned or re-entered.

paint.description: bg / border = textbox.paint; name = nameplate.paint.bg, shown while a name shows.

edge.description: An outline this wide (design px) in textbox.paint.bg under the fill, miter joins.

points.description: A polygon: [x, y] or [x, y, kx, ky] (moves kx, ky per unit of stretch).

ellipse.description: [x, y, kx, ky, rx, ry, degrees]: centre (moving as a point), radii, rotation.

align.description: start: the name's left edge at x; end: its right edge at x.

rotate.description: The name's turn on this side (else nameplate.rotate).

fontFaces.description: The skin's own font files (WOFF2 in its bundle), at most four, keyed by the id that body / name / ui / film name. weight = the face's weight; fallback = an installed library font id for the glyphs the face lacks; source = original (the game's own font) or tuned (bin/skin-fonts/<id>.json).

image.description: A bundle image: PNG / WebP, or a static SVG (inert drawing only - no script, style, text, external or embedded resources; a px width, height and viewBox on its root) for vector UI art.

artScale.description: Design-screen px per image px for this element's image(s): how large the original draws its sprites (a game whose UI units are not the design px); [x, y] when it stretches a sprite. Omitted = 1, the image's natural size.

menuStrip.description: A menu strip: its image at natural size (none: text only, text[1] wide, 2 * text[2] high), top-left x, y, the words in the text column [l, r] centred on y at font px, ink and alignment.

vertical.description: The words run top to bottom, centred on the text column and on y (a hanging plaque).

rule.description: A drawn rule hugging the words on both sides: the image as the right-hand rule at its natural size (design px), mirrored on the left, gap design px from the words.

artDecor.description: A still image at exactly one of `top` / `bottom` and one of `left` / `right` (px of the design screen, from the stage's edges).

scale.description: The image drawn at this many px per image px, as a button.

artButton.description: At exactly one of `top` / `bottom` and one of `left` / `right` (px of the design screen, from the stage's edges); `on` = the lit image (AUTO on).

tint.description: A mask the size of the image whose alpha takes the colour of the box trim (needs textbox.tint).

narrow.description: Phones (640px and less): the button's own phone art in place of the design image hung from the top edge - image (on = lit) at scale, its top and its left or right edge in the phones' touch unit (design px; the smallest phone button stays a 36px target); the key cap does not show there.

hint.description: The image's own input prompt (its first `w` design px) replaced by a key cap of the action's real stage key (the stage's binding table), `h` design px tall, in the textbox paint (fg face, bg ink) and the ui title font. `action` defaults to the button's own. The row is the cap, then the image's label part; hinted buttons hanging from one corner share one column edge (their outermost). Not with `tint`. The cap hides on touch screens.

privateUse.description: true = never export into a public/shared pack.

oneOf.description: hidden on step 0 of each period
mirrored for the second half of each period

seq.description: frame indices; one entry = hold that frame

phase.description: Costume/behaviour change at a cue-relative time (fields as phaseBody, plus cue/at).

paper.description: Procedural torn-paper bands along screen edges + a torn mat around the runtime textbox rect.

text.description: German/Latin text set in a decorative substitution script.

source.description: Where the phrase comes from (anime episode / quotation / authored).

hh.description: box height (fraction of frame) for noise/bars/fill

size.description: rune size as a fraction of frame height

ritual.description: Closed-set entry/exit ritual: a cover sheet assembled over the screen, then a reveal.

skinSwapAt.description: Page-boundary skin switch hidden under the cover.

onLevel.description: turn cue: fires when the skin level rises to this value (default 3)

levelLook.description: One skin level (director: skin <id> <level>). look "theme" = keep the stage theme textbox/nameplate/fonts while the overlay still plays; otherwise listed blocks replace the base blocks wholesale.

layout.description: box = the theme text box; scrim = full-width bottom fade to the scene (dark paint.bg); card = a floating opaque card; slash = layered jagged black / white plates, tilted choice bars; bubble / panel / band = translucent plates (speech balloon with a tail / rimmed panel / wide band with a rule and corner flourishes) whose text keeps 4.5:1 over any scene.

frame.description: Ornament bands live in the border band only (outside the content rect).

tint.description: figure = the plate takes the speaker's image colour, lightness-adjusted to keep paint.fg readable.

enter.description: unfold = a new name's plate opens from a line through its middle (.1 s, the Vita original); the name shows at once. Still under reduced motion.

font.description: Installed font ids (installed catalogue) or ids of the skin's own faces, every field optional. body is the stage role (text box; name, ui and titles fall back to it), film the cinematic subtitles (falls back to body, then the built-in subtitle stack). The user's per-machine override wins over ordinary skins; a director-applied performance skin's stage fonts win over it while active. Size, reduced motion and photosensitivity settings still apply.

sizeScale.description: multiplies the user's text size setting

wrap.description: phrase: the reading text breaks between phrases, not inside them - CJK runs keep whole up to punctuation or a space (word-break keep-all, strict kinsoku, the last lines evened out); a run wider than the line still breaks. From a 641px-wide screen; on phones the usual per-glyph breaking with kinsoku stays.

flash.description: colour of a just-revealed glyph (transient; exempt from contrast)

layout.description: capsule / orb fold the quick buttons, film mode, effects and exit into the system menu opened from one top-right control.

place.description: Bar controls inside the text box; at 640px and below attach under the box as four 44px targets.

narrow.description: Where the placed row (place) stands at 640px and below: bottom (default, its own strip under the lines) or top (its own strip at the box's top edge, right-aligned under the box image's top band; the lines below it).

button.description: The icon row's controls drawn as one buttonArt body each (needs icons): the state image by the control's state - on while lit (auto / skip running, the menu open), disabled when it cannot act - the hover image over it under the pointer / keyboard focus, the action's icon in the glyph box.

halo.description: A text's soft halo (a blurred underlay, not an outline) in design px: offset x, y, blur, colour and its opacity.

skinPose.description: A motion pose: dx / dy (em of the element's text; design px for menu items), rot degrees, scale, bright (1 = as drawn); never translucent.

skinMotion.description: 2-6 key poses at `at` (0..1 of ms; first 0, last 1, rising).

skinFrameMotion.description: skinMotion for a portrait frame (2-6 key poses at `at`), plus layer: frame (default) = the frame and its face move together, face = the entering face alone moves (dx / dy in % of the face square, its window cut riding with it) while the frame image, back and fill stay put; leave (layer face only, ms <= 400) = the poses the face it replaces plays before it goes.

skinStage.description: A staged list entrance / exit: every item from / to the pose over ms, the next stagger ms later.

skinSfxCue.description: A cue file, or {file, gain, every (type: one in every n glyphs), pitch (random rate spread)}.

buttonArt.description: Generic part: a drawn button body per state - normal, hover (under the pointer / keyboard focus), on (pressed: running, open), disabled (cannot act) - with the button's own glyph drawn in glyph [x, y, w, h] (fractions of the body, w / h > 0, inside it). A state without its image keeps the engine's lift (hover) or greying (disabled) on the body.

slice.description: Generic part: a 9-slice of a slot's image - [top, right, bottom, left] image px drawn as they are, the rest stretched with the slot; or {edges} (the same). One shape for every slot that slices (textbox, nameplate, choices, menu rows); where the slot's content sits stays the slot's own layout.

frames.description: Generic part: the slot's image is a sheet of equal cells (columns x rows, at least 2) played row-major at fps - count of them (default every cell; at most columns x rows), loop (default true; false = once, then the last frame stays). The frames are the slot's motion; reduced motion shows the rest frame (the first when looping, the last when played once). Slots: textbox.next ({image, frames}), textbox.lamp.frames.

playable.description: An image slot that may play frames: the image, or {image, frames} (frames: #/$defs/frames).

transitionShape.description: A flat shape that sweeps across the stage while the surface comes or goes (drawn by the engine, no image): from / to = its centre as 0..1 of the stage (may start or end off it), size = its height as a share of the stage height (a bar is 4 x as wide; a ring is a circle's outline a twentieth of its size wide), rot = degrees turned on the way, delay = share of ms before it starts, grow = [from, to] its scale on the way (a ripple spreading), fade = it fades out on the way.

anchor.description: portrait: from / to are offsets from the shown speaker portrait's centre (its rest place, fractions of the stage); no portrait shown, not drawn. box: y counts from the text box's top edge where it comes to rest (a box whose height follows its lines included), x from the stage's left; no box shown, not drawn.

transition.description: One surface transition (at least one of wipe, pose, fade, shapes, parts). enter plays from these values to the surface as drawn; leave from the surface as drawn to them. CONFIG 减少动态 shows the end state at once; the system reduced-motion preference turns it into a short fade.

delay.description: ms before the surface itself moves (its parts or shapes lead).

wipe.description: The surface revealed through a closed shape growing from at (0..1 of the surface, default centre): circle | rect | diamond | triangle; or an edge wipe: left (revealed from the left edge) | right | up (from the bottom) | down (from the top). leave shrinks it away.

pose.description: dx / dy in % of the surface, rot degrees, scale.

stagger.description: choices only: each row ms after the one before.

sameSpeaker.description: §18 N14 (transitions.page.enter only): the page's shapes play only on a page that keeps the speaker; a change of speaker (to, from or between speakers) turns quietly.

transitionEase.description: Named curves: linear, out (decelerate), in-out, back (overshoot), snap (sharp expo in-out), expo-out / quint-out (long decelerating tails), emphasized / emphasized-out / emphasized-in (Material 3 emphasized, its decelerate, its accelerate), spring (a settle with a 3% overshoot); or a cubic Bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2] with x in 0..1.

transitionParts.description: The surface's own parts (its direct children, in order) as a second layer (pose or fade required): enter from the pose / nothing to rest, delay ms after the transition starts, each next part stagger ms later; leave from rest away, before the surface (within its delay + ms). Not for choices (its rows are its parts) or page.

pose.description: dx / dy in % of the surface, rot degrees, scale.

quickButtonArt.description: buttonArt for the quick-menu row, with the phone's own bodies (narrow).

narrow.description: §18 N14: the phone's own bodies - each control is drawn 44 CSS px tall at this body's aspect, its glyph in this glyph box (a wide desktop chip that small would shrink its label out of reading).
